explanation: The Sayfo was carried out under cover of the war and by the state that was fighting it. Ottoman forces and allied Kurdish tribes killed and deported Assyrian and Syriac Christians from south-eastern Anatolia and Persian Azerbaijan in the same years, using the same apparatus and the same reasoning of an internal enemy as in the Armenian genocide this atlas already holds. What the war supplied was the front line that ran through where these communities lived, the requisitioning, and the suspension of any authority that might have refused. It did not supply the intention, which was the Committee of Union and Progress’s own. That is why this is enabled and not caused.
